Snapshot filename parsing, latest snapshot selection, and old snapshot removal utilities.

# Purpose
This C file implements helper functions for a snapshot archive directory. It parses snapshot file names in [`fd_ssarchive_parse_filename`](<#fd_ssarchive_parse_filename>), which accepts names in the `snapshot-<slot>-<hash>.tar.zst` and `incremental-snapshot-<full_slot>-<incremental_slot>-<hash>.tar.zst` formats. The function extracts the slot numbers and decodes the base58 hash into a binary buffer. The file also defines [`fd_ssarchive_latest_pair`](<#fd_ssarchive_latest_pair>), which scans a directory to find the newest full snapshot and, when requested, the newest incremental snapshot that matches that full snapshot.

The file also provides [`fd_ssarchive_remove_old_snapshots`](<#fd_ssarchive_remove_old_snapshots>), which scans the same directory, collects full and incremental snapshot files, sorts them by slot, and removes older files beyond the configured retention limits. It uses directory access functions from POSIX, logging and error handling helpers from the surrounding code base, and a generated sort routine for ordering snapshot entries.
